species.size: Minimum Size Limit: 54 inches fork length; hammerhead sharks 78 inches FL or greater; no minimum for Atlantic Sharpnose, Bonnethead, Blacknose, and Finetooth
species.limit: 1 per vessel (Atlantic Sharpnose and Bonnethead: 1 per person)
species.quote: SHARKS (All species except smooth and spiny dog sharks) Minimum Size Limit: 54 inches fork length ** Possession Limit: 1 per vessel *** … Season Closed May 15 - July 15
species.notes: Recreationally Prohibited Species (illegal to take or possess): Atlantic Angel, Dusky, Sand Tiger, Sandbar, White, and Bigeye Thresher Sharks. All sharks must be landed with head and fins attached. Sharks may only be taken by handline or rod and reel; spearing and bowfishing illegal. No size or possession limits apply to dog sharks.

species.season: January 1 through March 31; May 16 through December 31
species.size: Minimum Size Limit: 28 inches; Maximum Size Limit: 31 inches
species.quote: STRIPED BASS (ROCKFISH, STRIPED) Virginia Coastal Seasons January 1 through March 31 May 16 through December 31 Minimum Size Limit: 28 inches Maximum Size Limit: 31 inches Possession Limit: 1 per person
species.notes: Non-offset, corrodible, non-stainless steel circle hooks required when fishing with bait. Gaffing striped bass is illegal in Virginia marine waters. You may not combine possession limits when seasons overlap or you fish in multiple jurisdictions. Coastal regulations apply in the Territorial Sea plus the seaside creeks, bays and inlets of Accomack and Northampton Counties and the City of Virginia Beach.

species.season: Spring: May 16 through June 15; Fall: October 4 through December 31
species.size: Minimum Size Limit: 19 inches; Maximum Size Limit: 24 inches
species.quote: Chesapeake Bay Spring Season Season: May 16 through June 15 Minimum Size Limit: 19 inches Maximum Size Limit: 24 inches Possession Limit: 1 per person / Chesapeake Bay Fall Season Season: October 4 through December 31 Minimum Size Limit: 19 inches Maximum Size Limit: 24 inches Possession Limit: 1 per person
species.notes: Applies in the main stem of the Chesapeake Bay and Virginia Bay tributaries except tributaries of the Potomac River (Potomac River Fisheries Commission rules apply there).

species.quote: Federal water striped bass regulations: Atlantic Ocean waters beyond the 3 mile limit are closed to the taking and possession of striped bass all year.
STURGEON Code Section 28.2-303 Illegal to possess

species.size: Minimum Size Limit January 1-May 31: 16 Inches; June 1-December 31: 17.5 Inches
species.quote: SUMMER FLOUNDER Minimum Size Limit January 1-May 31: 16 Inches Minimum Size Limit June 1-December 31: 17.5 Inches Possession Limit: 4 per person Season: Open year-round
species.notes: Applies to Virginia tidal waters; in Virginia Potomac River tributaries the PRFC mainstem rules apply. Federal-waters rules are set by NMFS.

species.quote: TAUTOG Minimum Size Limit: 16 IN. Possession Limit: 4 per person Season: Closed Season: May 16 - June 30
